`synthetic-speech.wav` is a 2.5-second mono 16 kHz excerpt generated with the
project's authorized Gnani account. It says part of a generic AI greeting, contains
no customer data, and is used to test the actual Silero model without network calls.

`correction.wav` and `second-correction.wav` are generated English requests to
change an appointment to Friday at eleven, then Saturday at two. The local-only
browser harness injects them through a virtual microphone during AI speech.
